name: MCP Gateway
description: Federated MCP gateway as a Tier-2 (container) app: exposes stdio MCP servers over Streamable HTTP + a /link WebSocket for gateway-to-gateway federation (flat namespace, first-registered-wins, per-peer tokens, federation-depth limit). Built from this repo's back/gateway/ (server.py, upstream.py, remote_upstream.py, token_store.py), image published by this repo's .github/workflows/publish.yml. ADDITIVE: coexists with the monolith's src/mcp/gateway.py (in-repo, profiles + /lazy) — this app federates only; the in-repo gateway is strangled later once this reaches parity (see docs/knowledge_base/architecture/mcp-gateway-app-federation.md).
